generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The method `match(Object value, String pattern, Boolean caseInsensitive)` compiles the regex pattern on every invocation via `Pattern.compile`. Since this replaces the `RegexProcessor` which cached the compiled `Pattern`, calling this method during row-by-row evaluation will introduce significant performance overhead.

The `doApply` method is implemented as a stub that always returns `null`, whereas in `BinaryComparisonOperation` (#JN2AJ), `doApply` contains the core logic called by `apply`. This inconsistency suggests that `BinaryLogicOperation` may be incorrectly implementing the `PredicateBiFunction` interface if `doApply` is intended to be the primary execution point.
